Subject: Request: brief executive blurb for Azure co-sell listing

Hi Elena —

Hope you’re well. We’re getting HealthGrid’s Azure Marketplace profile ready for the co-sell badge and wanted to ask for a very short executive blurb we can display on the listing (one sentence, ~15–25 words). Example: “Redwood Inference helped us reduce inference latency by 3x while lowering per-token cost.”

If you’re able to share a one-liner and the signatory’s job title (CEO / Head of Product, etc.), we’ll include it alongside your logo. If legal prefers a quick sign-off, we can send a DocuSign template — otherwise a reply to this email works fine.

Attached is a short doc with sample blurb options to make this easy. Would you be able to send something by EOD Friday (June 4)?

Thanks so much — really appreciate it.

Best,
Monica Patel
Principal Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

I’ve initiated a DocuSign template (link below) — when you click it you’ll see the quote pre-filled and a single signature field for Marco Rivera. If easiest, Marco can reply to this email with authorization and we’ll save that in the file, but DocuSign speeds the process.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/templates/XYZ-HealthGrid

If you’d rather skip DocuSign, just reply with a one-line permission (e.g., “HealthGrid grants Redwood permission to publish the quote…”). Once we have the sign-off, Vanessa will queue the asset and I’ll confirm when the Azure listing goes live.

Thank you — really appreciate the quick turnaround.
